sources.excerpt: Scorpion by Broughton Audio | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Broughton Audio Scorpion LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE EQUALIZER Description The Scorpion is a highly adaptive overdrive pedal designed specifically with bassists in mind. The Scorpion stands out by implementing a resonant feedback circuit, allowing the dynamics and punch of your clean signal to come through without the need for a clean blend. Unlike most overdrives that offer a baked-in signature tone, the Scorpion can be transparent or transformative. Allow your inherent tone to shine, or reshape it entirely into a powerful, cutting bass tone. The Depth knob gives complete control of the low frequency clipping, ranging from a lean, grindy tone, all the way to a full on bass distortion. Increasing the Depth knob allows more lows to be clipped, making the signal thicker and heavier. Broughton Audio, Toronto-based and run by bassist Josh Broughton, produces high-quality effects designed specifically for bass players. The Scorpion is a three-band EQ designed for bass guitar. The three bands are voiced to complement bass guitar frequencies rather than using standard guitar EQ centers. Provides useful tone shaping for cutting through mixes or matching room acoustics. Standard 9V DC operation with Boss-style center-negative connector. Handmade in limited batches in Canada, making these pedals highly sought after.
